CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_ack_blob_removal(reference text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(session_user, 'predictive_retention_owner', 'MEMBER') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-retention-role-refused' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.predictive_blob_reference_guard(reference);
  DELETE FROM public.predictive_blob_removals WHERE storage_ref = reference;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_retention_authorizations a WHERE a.txid = pg_catalog.pg_current_xact_id()) THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-append-only' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_blob_reference_guard(reference text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF reference IS NULL OR reference !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}\.(json|csv)$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-blob-reference-refused' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.predictive_blob_lock_guard(substr(reference, 1, 64));
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_blob_referenced(reference text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.predictive_blob_reference_guard(reference);
  RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_blobs WHERE storage_ref = reference);
END
$function$

  IF jsonb_typeof(outcome) <> 'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF kind = 'participation' THEN
    RETURN (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(outcome) key) = ARRAY['state']
      AND (outcome->>'state' IN ('offensive-participant','zero-offensive-participation','inactive-or-dnp','unresolved','conflicting')) IS TRUE;
  END IF;
  IF kind = 'snap-source-compatibility' THEN
    RETURN (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(outcome) key) = ARRAY['overlapGames','result']
      AND (outcome->>'result' IN ('compatible','incompatible','insufficient-overlap')) IS TRUE
      AND public.predictive_integer(outcome->'overlapGames', 0, 4096)
      AND ((outcome->>'result' = 'insufficient-overlap') = ((outcome->>'overlapGames')::integer = 0));
  END IF;
  IF kind = 'completion' THEN
    RETURN (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(outcome) key) = ARRAY['actualEnd','completionObservedAt','state']
      AND (outcome->>'state' IN ('scheduled','in-progress','completed','suspended','postponed','conflicting')) IS TRUE
      AND outcome->'actualEnd' = 'null'::jsonb
      AND CASE WHEN outcome->>'state' = 'completed' THEN public.predictive_instant(outcome->>'completionObservedAt')
        ELSE outcome->'completionObservedAt' = 'null'::jsonb END;
  END IF;
  IF kind <> 'reconciliation' OR
    (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(outcome) key) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['result','rule','selectedObservationId']
    THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  RETURN (outcome->>'result' IN ('selected','conflict','insufficient-sources')) IS TRUE
    AND (outcome->>'rule' IN ('single-source','sources-agree','material-discrepancy','no-candidates')) IS TRUE
    AND CASE WHEN outcome->>'result' = 'selected' THEN public.predictive_text(outcome->'selectedObservationId')
      ELSE outcome->'selectedObservationId' = 'null'::jsonb END;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN false;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_publication_check()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE affected text[];
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'predictive_captures' THEN
    IF NEW.state = 'published' THEN
      IF (SELECT status FROM public.predictive_ingestion_runs WHERE id = NEW.run_id) <> 'published'
          OR (SELECT retrieval_kind FROM public.predictive_artifacts WHERE id = NEW.artifact_id) <> 'full' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-publication-invalid' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
      END IF;
      -- Historical authorization: only rights known when the bytes were captured.
      IF NOT public.predictive_rights_allow((SELECT profile_id FROM public.predictive_artifacts WHERE id = NEW.artifact_id),
          NEW.captured_at, NEW.captured_at, 'internal-research') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-rights-not-in-force' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
      END IF;
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_run_rights rr WHERE rr.run_id = NEW.run_id AND rr.rights_decision_id =
          public.predictive_rights_in_force((SELECT profile_id FROM public.predictive_artifacts WHERE id = NEW.artifact_id), NEW.captured_at, NEW.captured_at)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-run-rights-missing' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF (SELECT p.purpose FROM public.predictive_artifacts a JOIN public.predictive_source_profiles p ON p.id = a.profile_id
        WHERE a.id = NEW.artifact_id) = 'synthetic-test' AND NOT public.predictive_harness_session() THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-synthetic-outside-harness' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT array_agg(observation_id) INTO affected FROM public.predictive_artifact_observations WHERE artifact_id = NEW.artifact_id;
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'predictive_observations' THEN affected := ARRAY[NEW.id];
  ELSE affected := ARRAY[NEW.observation_id]; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_artifact_observations l
      JOIN public.predictive_observations o ON o.id = l.observation_id
      JOIN public.predictive_artifacts a ON a.id = l.artifact_id
      JOIN public.predictive_source_profiles p ON p.id = a.profile_id
      WHERE o.id = ANY(affected) AND (o.profile_id <> a.profile_id OR NOT o.kind = ANY(p.evidence_kinds) OR a.retrieval_kind <> 'full')) OR
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_observations o WHERE o.id = ANY(affected) AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_artifact_observations l JOIN public.predictive_captures c ON c.artifact_id = l.artifact_id
      WHERE l.observation_id = o.id AND c.state = 'published')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-publication-invalid' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  -- bridge-v1: both ambiguity directions, at overlapping knowledge times and
  -- (for players) effective windows. Later corrections cannot hide old conflicts.
  IF EXISTS (WITH known AS (
      SELECT o.id, o.predecessor_id, min(greatest(c.available_at, c.ingested_at)) AS since
      FROM public.predictive_observations o JOIN public.predictive_artifact_observations l ON l.observation_id = o.id
      JOIN public.predictive_captures c ON c.artifact_id = l.artifact_id
      JOIN public.predictive_ingestion_runs r ON r.id = c.run_id
      WHERE c.state = 'published' AND r.status = 'published' GROUP BY o.id, o.predecessor_id
    ), windows AS (
      SELECT k.id, k.since, coalesce(min(n.since), 'infinity'::timestamptz) AS until
      FROM known k LEFT JOIN known n ON n.predecessor_id = k.id GROUP BY k.id, k.since
    ) SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_observations o JOIN windows ow ON ow.id = o.id
      JOIN public.predictive_observations h ON h.kind = o.kind AND h.profile_id = o.profile_id AND h.id <> o.id
        AND h.data->>'provider' = o.data->>'provider'
      JOIN windows hw ON hw.id = h.id AND hw.since < ow.until AND ow.since < hw.until
      WHERE o.id = ANY(affected) AND o.kind IN ('player-bridge','game-bridge')
        AND ((o.kind = 'game-bridge' AND ((h.entity_key = o.entity_key AND h.game_id <> o.game_id)
            OR (h.entity_key <> o.entity_key AND h.game_id = o.game_id)))
          OR (o.kind = 'player-bridge' AND ((h.entity_key = o.entity_key AND h.player_id <> o.player_id)
            OR (h.entity_key <> o.entity_key AND h.player_id = o.player_id))
            AND (h.data->>'effectiveFrom')::timestamptz < (o.data->>'effectiveTo')::timestamptz
            AND (o.data->>'effectiveFrom')::timestamptz < (h.data->>'effectiveTo')::timestamptz))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-bridge-ambiguous' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_observations o WHERE o.id = ANY(affected) AND o.kind = 'source-row-absent'
      AND NOT public.predictive_absence_valid(o.id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-absence-invalid' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  -- Every correction's first usable capture must follow an independently
  -- usable predecessor in the same source chain.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_observations o
    JOIN public.predictive_artifact_observations l ON l.observation_id = o.id
    JOIN public.predictive_captures c ON c.artifact_id = l.artifact_id AND c.state = 'published'
    WHERE o.id = ANY(affected) AND o.predecessor_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_artifact_observations pl JOIN public.predictive_captures pc ON pc.artifact_id = pl.artifact_id
      WHERE pl.observation_id = o.predecessor_id AND pc.state = 'published'
        AND pc.available_at <= c.available_at AND pc.ingested_at <= c.ingested_at)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-correction-time-invalid' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
    SELECT id, predecessor_id, ARRAY[id] AS path, false AS cycle FROM public.predictive_observations WHERE id = ANY(affected) AND predecessor_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT c.id, o.predecessor_id, c.path || o.id, o.id = ANY(c.path)
      FROM chain c JOIN public.predictive_observations o ON o.id = c.predecessor_id WHERE NOT c.cycle)
    SELECT 1 FROM chain WHERE cycle) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-correction-cycle' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_source_consumer_check(record_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c public.predictive_source_consumers; profiles text[]; rights jsonb; expected jsonb; actual jsonb; m jsonb; t timestamptz;
BEGIN
  IF NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(session_user,'predictive_replay','MEMBER') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'source-consumer-replay-not-authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.predictive_source_consumers WHERE id=record_id;
  IF c.id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  t:=date_trunc('milliseconds',pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()); m:=c.body->'manifest';
  profiles:=public.predictive_source_consumer_validate(c.body,t,c.recorded_at);
  rights:=coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(r ORDER BY r COLLATE "C") FROM (SELECT DISTINCT public.predictive_rights_in_force(p,c.recorded_at,c.recorded_at) AS r
    FROM unnest(profiles) p) x),'[]');
  expected:=jsonb_build_object(
    'bindings',ARRAY(SELECT b.id FROM public.predictive_source_bindings b WHERE b.profile_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(m->'profileIds'))
      AND b.recorded_at<=c.cutoff ORDER BY b.id COLLATE "C"),
    'sourceDecisions',ARRAY(SELECT d.id FROM public.predictive_source_decisions d WHERE d.plan->'witness'->'profileIds'=m->'profileIds'
      AND d.entity_key IN (SELECT x->>'entityKey' FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'sources') x) AND d.recorded_at<=c.cutoff ORDER BY d.id COLLATE "C"),
    'observations',ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT id COLLATE "C" FROM (
      SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(m->'observations') AS id UNION SELECT x.observation_id FROM public.predictive_source_decisions d
      JOIN public.predictive_source_decision_inputs x ON x.decision_id=d.id WHERE d.plan->'witness'->'profileIds'=m->'profileIds'
        AND d.entity_key IN (SELECT x->>'entityKey' FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'sources') x) AND d.recorded_at<=c.cutoff) x ORDER BY 1),
    'decisions',m->'decisions','rights',rights);
  actual:=jsonb_build_object(
    'bindings',ARRAY(SELECT binding_id FROM public.predictive_source_consumer_bindings WHERE consumer_id=c.id ORDER BY binding_id COLLATE "C"),
    'sourceDecisions',ARRAY(SELECT decision_id FROM public.predictive_source_consumer_source_decisions WHERE consumer_id=c.id ORDER BY decision_id COLLATE "C"),
    'observations',ARRAY(SELECT observation_id FROM public.predictive_source_consumer_observations WHERE consumer_id=c.id ORDER BY observation_id COLLATE "C"),
    'decisions',ARRAY(SELECT decision_id FROM public.predictive_source_consumer_decisions WHERE consumer_id=c.id ORDER BY decision_id COLLATE "C"),
    'rights',ARRAY(SELECT rights_decision_id FROM public.predictive_source_consumer_rights WHERE consumer_id=c.id ORDER BY rights_decision_id COLLATE "C"));
  IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected OR c.body_sha256<>public.predictive_source_digest(c.body)
      OR c.execution_digest<>public.predictive_source_digest(jsonb_build_object('bodySha256',c.body_sha256,'rightsDecisions',rights,'recordedAt',public.predictive_source_time(c.recorded_at))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'stored-source-consumer-mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'kind',c.kind,'predecessorId',c.predecessor_id,'recordedAt',public.predictive_source_time(c.recorded_at),
    'mode',c.mode,'body',c.body,'bodySha256',c.body_sha256,'executionDigest',c.execution_digest,'rightsDecisions',rights);
END
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$ SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',$2,'observationId',o.id,'profileId',o.profile_id,
  'sourceKey',o.source_key,'captureId',c.id,'artifactId',a.id,'artifactSha256',a.blob_sha256,
  'availableAt',public.predictive_source_time(c.available_at),'ingestedAt',public.predictive_source_time(c.ingested_at))), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.predictive_observations o JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.* FROM public.predictive_artifact_observations l JOIN public.predictive_captures c ON c.artifact_id=l.artifact_id
    JOIN public.predictive_ingestion_runs r ON r.id=c.run_id WHERE l.observation_id=o.id AND c.state='published' AND r.status='published'
      AND c.available_at <= $3 AND c.ingested_at <= $3
    ORDER BY c.ingested_at,c.available_at,c.captured_at,c.id COLLATE "C" LIMIT 1) c ON true
  JOIN public.predictive_artifacts a ON a.id=c.artifact_id WHERE o.id=ANY($1) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_source_request_key(req jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE parts text[];
BEGIN
  IF public.predictive_source_exact(req,ARRAY['profileId','rawGameId','rawTeam','rawPlayerId','cutoff']) IS NOT TRUE
      OR public.predictive_text(req->'profileId') IS NOT TRUE OR (req->>'profileId') ~ '[|]'
      OR public.predictive_instant(req->>'cutoff') IS NOT TRUE
      OR jsonb_typeof(req->'rawGameId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR (req->>'rawGameId') !~ '^2026_[0-9]{2}_[A-Z]{2,3}_[A-Z]{2,3}$'
      OR jsonb_typeof(req->'rawTeam') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (req->'rawPlayerId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb AND public.predictive_identity(req->'rawPlayerId','player') IS NOT TRUE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-source-request-invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  parts:=string_to_array(req->>'rawGameId','_');
  IF parts[2]::integer NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 22 OR parts[3]=parts[4] OR (req->>'rawTeam') <> ALL(parts[3:4])
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_teams WHERE id='nfl:team:' || parts[3])
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.predictive_teams WHERE id='nfl:team:' || parts[4]) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-source-request-invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN public.predictive_source_digest(jsonb_build_array(req->>'rawGameId',req->>'rawTeam') ||
    CASE WHEN req->'rawPlayerId'='null'::jsonb THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_array(req->>'rawPlayerId') END);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_source_witness(req jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT (pg_catalog.pg_has_role(session_user,'predictive_replay','MEMBER')
      OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(session_user,'predictive_recorder','MEMBER')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-source-witness-not-authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN public.predictive_source_witness_at(req,pg_catalog.date_trunc('milliseconds',pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()));
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_text(value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string' AND length(value #>> '{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 256
    AND (value #>> '{}') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' AND length(btrim(value #>> '{}')) > 0
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.predictive_unpin_check()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.unpinned_at < (SELECT pinned_at FROM public.predictive_feature_run_pins WHERE id = NEW.pin_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'predictive-unpin-before-pin' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
